tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a fresh full-body neutral visual-novel sprite of Aether from Genshin Impact. Image 1 is the official portrait, guiding identity, costume and polished anime illustration style. Image 2 is the user-provided in-game model, guiding face, skin tone, hair, outfit, accessories and colors. Preserve these details faithfully; translate the model into the illustration style of the official portrait. Use petite Medium Male proportions. Pose: friendly and attentive, standing at ease, body slightly turned toward the viewer, both arms resting naturally at his sides, facing generally toward the viewer with naturally hanging clothing and hair and a neutral expression. For the eyes, closely follow both references: two naturally matched, clearly separated golden amber eyes, each with a single intact almond-shaped outline, upper and lower eyelids meeting at the corners, a coherent round iris and one normal centered dark pupil, with small restrained catchlights. Keep each pupil inside its own iris, retain the visible iris border, and align both eyes and gaze naturally on the face. No warped, doubled, overlapping or extra eye features. Separate the right and left hands, naturally articulated, each with a palm, four fingers and a separate opposable thumb, without forcing hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet comfortably separated. One coherent mouth. No weapon. Full silhouette including hair, headwear, hands and shoes visible, approximately 2–4% padding above and below. Polished anime game artwork on a genuinely transparent background. No scenery, UI, labels, watermark, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
